notes.title: Toolset first peek!
notes.content:
[p][b]First Peek! [/b][/p][p]We’re so excited to share a little more of [i]Silkgrove[/i] with you today!
Alongside a short teaser of the world, we’ve also put together a small gameplay gif to give you a first look at toolset gameplay. (Teaser on store page)[/p][p]This is just the beginning, but we wanted to bring you along as Silkgrove starts to take shape. Your feedback and support mean the world to us, and every wishlist helps us get closer to launch.[/p][p]Thank you for being here with us.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45568046/663aea0729ea7b9be8b16d962cc1649f870b4e95.gif"][/img][/p]
